falsifiers.C_labels_alone_have_no_robustness: A tenant/path-controlled label resists semantic corruption without any external verifier, protected signing boundary, or independently observed receipt.
falsifiers.H_provenance_origin_is_required: Self-attested/spoofable quality fields remain calibrated under a compromised path, or origin-aware verification gives no discrimination under attacks that actually change metric decisions.
falsifiers.H_quality_vector_beats_sample_count: On held-out corruption topologies at matched calibration coverage, the trusted quality gate fails to lower selective error or fails to avoid at least as many negative-control causal promotions as sample_count alone.

provenance_origin_decision_law: A quality vector may gate acceptance only when generated or independently verified outside the measured/possibly compromised path. Self-attested or spoofable quality fields force UNKNOWN until externally verified.
same_lineage_notice: Same provider/model ancestry may exist; this is not an independent replication.
